Subject: Re: Fwd: RazorBank — follow-up & questionnaire (post-demo) — intake for security review

Thanks for the ping, Logan. I reviewed the questionnaire and the network diagram. High level thoughts and a proposed intake scope below.

Minimal artifact set to start (Tier 1 intake):
- Completed questionnaire (we have a draft — good).
- Network diagram (we have initial).
- List of third-party vendors and OAuth / SSO providers.
- Data classification mapping for the two workflows (PII / financial markers).
- Preferred regions and whether keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM).

Scope recommendation:
- Start with a scoped review limited to the cloud-hosted US region and only the transaction enrichment API endpoints (production and staging). Exclude the doc-ingest pipeline for the first pass — we can add it in phase 2.
- Confirm whether RazorBank requires us to bring Redwood Private (VPC) vs Dedicated in a single-tenant arrangement — that will change network requirements and timeline.

Questions / blockers:
- The diagram shows an on-prem analytics cluster using a VPN to cloud; we need to know if the product will pull data from that cluster (if yes, that will increase the attack surface and require additional controls).
- Do they require Redwood to rotate keys into their KMS/HSM or will they accept our managed KMS with customer key-wrap?

Proposed two-week intake timeline (we can compress if procurement prioritizes):
Week 1: confirm scope, collect missing artifacts (vendor list, key management preference), and conduct initial architecture review.
Week 2: provide a preliminary findings memo + map of additional evidence needed for SOC2 / contractual commitments.

I'll draft the preliminary intake checklist and send to Asha and procurement. Marissa, please attach the MAP you prepared so procurement has milestones to align against their 6–8 week cycle.

—
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Hi all,

Thanks for the rapid follow-up. Procurement confirms the internal timeline: we will run vendor vetting and SOW negotiations in parallel with the security intake. Two asks from our side so the SOW can be reviewed by budget holders next week:
1) Please share the MAP and a short milestone table showing deliverables and acceptance criteria (we need this for our internal PO approval).
2) Any sample SOC2 artifacts you can provide (system description, control list) to speed legal review would be helpful.

We agree with the scope limitation to transaction enrichment in US regions for the first pass — that makes the timeline workable. Please treat the doc-ingest pipeline as phase 2.

We will aim to provide vendor evaluation feedback by Feb 5. If Redwood can share the MAP and the preliminary intake memo by EOD Friday, we can slot you into next week's procurement cut.

Regards,
